copernicus-ads.display_name: Copernicus Atmosphere Data Store (ADS) personal access token
copernicus-ads.breakage: the CAMS gas and aerosol fields cannot be downloaded, so the rows that take their initial and boundary values from CAMS would start at zero and receive only their default inflow
copernicus-ads.remedy: Write two lines to ~/.adsapirc in the same format as ~/.cdsapirc: the url line 'url: https://ads.atmosphere.copernicus.eu/api' and a key line holding the personal access token after the word key and a colon. The token is on the ADS profile page; the same ECMWF account token the CDS uses is accepted by the ADS (checked 2026-09-30). Then log in to https://ads.atmosphere.copernicus.eu once and accept the site policies and the CAMS dataset licence.
